facts.fact: Universal Ads is launching its Mobile App Promotion product for TV with partnerships across five mobile measurement partners (MMPs): Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, and Singular.
facts.quote: Today, we are launching our Mobile App Promotion product for TV, with partnerships across five leading MMPs: Adjust, AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, and Singular.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that advertisers can run App Promotion campaigns on premium TV with no added markups.
facts.quote: Now advertisers can run App Promotion campaigns on premium TV with no added markups and measure installs and post-install events directly in the same MMP dashboard

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that the TV app promotion setup requires no additional SDK, since advertisers use infrastructure they already have.
facts.quote: No additional SDK is required. Advertisers use the infrastructure they already have in place

facts.fact: Advertisers create a CTV-to-Mobile attribution link through their existing MMP account and append it to their App Promotion campaign in the UA Ads Manager.
facts.quote: Advertisers create a CTV-to-Mobile attribution link through their existing Adjust, AppsFlyer, Kochava, Singular, or Branch account and append it to their App Promotion campaign in the UA Ads Manager.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that app installs and post-install events are attributed in the MMP using CTV-based attribution and existing attribution windows.
facts.quote: App installs and post-install events (like purchases and sign-ups) are attributed in the MMP using CTV-based attribution and existing attribution windows

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that standard campaign metrics such as impressions, spend, and delivery are visible in its reporting dashboard.
facts.quote: Standard campaign metrics like impressions, spend, and delivery are visible directly in the Universal Ads reporting dashboard

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that advertisers can reach and retarget first-party audiences on TV using custom audience uploads, including re-engaging lapsed users and suppressing recent installers.
facts.quote: Advertisers can reach and retarget first-party audiences on TV using custom audience uploads, including re-engaging lapsed users, suppressing recent installers, or targeting high-value segments
